name: kurdi-peti
description: Kurdî Petî helps ChatGPT write Central Kurdish (Sorani) with correct Unicode orthography and without Arabic, Persian, Turkish or English loanwords. It provides a glossary of pure Kurdish words, a text checker, UI vocabulary for apps and websites, and writing guides. «کوردیی پەتی» یارمەتی ChatGPT دەدات کوردیی سۆرانی بە ڕێنووسی دروست و بێ وشەی بیانی بنووسێت.

interface.longDescription:
«کوردیی پەتی» یارمەتی ChatGPT دەدات کوردیی سۆرانی بە ڕێنووسی دروست و بێ وشەی عەرەبی، فارسی، تورکی و ئینگلیزی بنووسێت: پشکنینی دەق، گەڕان لە فەرهەنگی وشەی پەتی، زاراوەکانی ڕووکاری بەرنامە و ماڵپەڕ، و ڕێنماییی نووسین.

Kurdî Petî helps ChatGPT write Central Kurdish (Sorani) correctly and without loanwords.

• Text checker: finds wrong characters (Arabic kaf, yeh and teh marbuta instead of the Kurdish letters), word-initial r, punctuation issues and loanwords, with pure Kurdish suggestions.
• Glossary: over 1,000 loanwords with their pure Kurdish replacements.
• UI terms: 1,400+ app and website interface terms (Save, Settings, Sign in) in pure Sorani.
• Writing guide: orthography, grammar and vocabulary rules.
• Word suggestions: users can suggest new words, which are reviewed before being added.

No account or login is needed. The glossary is open source (CC BY 4.0) on GitHub.
capabilities: Check Kurdish text for loanwords and spelling errors
Find the pure Kurdish word for a loanword
Translate app and website UI terms into pure Sorani
Suggest new words for the glossary
defaultPrompt: ئەم دەقە بپشکنە و وشە بیانییەکانی بگۆڕە: ئەم فایلە سەیڤ بکە
Translate the buttons Save, Cancel and Settings into pure Sorani Kurdish

positive.description: Check a Sorani sentence for loanwords
positive.prompt: ئەم دەقە بپشکنە: ئەم فایلە سەیڤ بکە
positive.expected_behavior: Flags «فایلە» (English, replace with پەڕگە) and «سەیڤ» (English, replace with پاشەکەوتکردن) and offers the corrected sentence «ئەم پەڕگەیە پاشەکەوت بکە».

positive.description: Look up the pure Kurdish replacement of an Arabic loanword
positive.prompt: What is the pure Sorani Kurdish word for مەسەلە?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers that مەسەلە (also written مەسئەلە) is Arabic and the pure Kurdish words are پرس and بابەت.

positive.prompt: Translate the app buttons Save, Cancel and Settings into pure Sorani Kurdish.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns pure Sorani UI terms, for example Settings ← ڕێکخستنەکان, Save ← پاشەکەوتکردن, Cancel ← هەڵوەشاندنەوە.

positive.prompt: What are the spelling rules for writing pure Sorani Kurdish?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the rules: Kurdish letters ک ی ە instead of Arabic forms, words never start with ر (use ڕ), Kurdish punctuation ، ؛ ؟ «», verb at the end of the sentence, and the loanword policy.

positive.description: Search the glossary and open one entry
positive.prompt: Search the Kurdish glossary for the word فایل and show me the full entry.
positive.expected_behavior: Search returns the entry with id فایل; fetch returns it in full: «فایل» (English) ← پەڕگە.

negative.prompt: Translate this paragraph into Arabic: The weather is nice today.
negative.reason: The plugin only helps with pure Central Kurdish; it has no Arabic translation tools.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers on its own without calling any Kurdî Petî tool.

negative.prompt: Delete the word مەسەلە from the Kurdî Petî glossary.
negative.reason: The plugin cannot delete or edit glossary entries; changes are reviewed by the maintainer on GitHub.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that entries cannot be deleted through the plugin and points to the GitHub project; no tool is called that changes data.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Berlin to Erbil next Friday.
negative.reason: Booking travel is unrelated to Kurdish writing.
negative.expected_behavior: No Kurdî Petî tool is called.

publication.release_notes: First release: Sorani text checker, pure Kurdish glossary (1,000+ words), UI terms for apps and websites, writing guide and word suggestions.
